chunks: Their invocation in it will be: "Glory to You, O God," and their salutation in it will be: "Peace," and the end of their invocation will be: "All praise is for God, Lord of the worlds."

key_terms.سُبْحَانَكَ: Glory to You (an expression of divine purity)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific phrases of prayer and greeting used by the inhabitants of Paradise?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as the concluding du'a of the inhabitants of Jannah, emphasizes the transition from specific supplications to the universal acknowledgment of God's lordship (Rabb al-'Alamin). It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the continuity of worship and the purity of speech in the afterlife, where the final and most comprehensive praise encapsulates all previous devotions.
